transform.sql: WITH HOST_AND_LDEV AS( SELECT DISTINCT PD_NHC.COLLECTION_TIME, PD_LDC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER, CASE WHEN PD_NHC.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME IS NOT NULL THEN PD_NHC.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME ELSE PD_NHC.NVM_HOST_NQN END AS NVM_HOST_NICKNAME FROM PD_LDC_LATEST JOIN PD_NNPC_LATEST ON PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID = PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID AND PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_SUBSYSTEM_ID = PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_SUBSYSTEM_ID JOIN PD_NHC ON PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN = PD_NHC.NVM_HOST_NQN ) SELECT PD_VVC.DATETIME, PD_VVC.POOL_ID, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.FREE_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_FREE_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.USED_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_USED_CAPACITY, CAST(SUM(PD_VVC.VIRTUAL_VOLUME_CAPACITY) / 1024 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS SUM_VIRTUAL_VOLUME_CAPACITY, CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN PD_PLC.POOL_ID ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END AS NULL_IGNORED_POOL_NAME, CONCAT( CASE WHEN PD_PLC.POOL_NAME IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE PD_PLC.POOL_NAME END, '(', PD_PLC.POOL_ID, ')' ) AS POOL_DISPLAY_NAME, HOST_AND_LDEV.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME FROM PD_VVC JOIN PD_PLC ON PD_VVC.COLLECTION_TIME = PD_PLC.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_VVC.POOL_ID = PD_PLC.POOL_ID JOIN HOST_AND_LDEV ON PD_VVC.COLLECTION_TIME = HOST_AND_LDEV.COLLECTION_TIME AND PD_VVC.LDEV_NUMBER = HOST_AND_LDEV.LDEV_NUMBER GROUP BY PD_VVC.DATETIME, PD_VVC.POOL_ID, PD_PLC.POOL_NAME, HOST_AND_LDEV.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME;
